services.desc: We have several different routes that we have available to our captains on the M/V Summer Breeze. The arrows on the map marked in light blue indicate our main route that we use. In the event of high winds, increased wake activity, or deteriorating weather conditions we will use our yellow route and if there is severe weather in the surrounding area then we will hold on the red arrow pattern in order to stay close to Chesapeake City.
